title: Verification of the Beer-Lambert Law via Optical Absorbance
description: Measurement of optical density and determination of molar absorptivity (epsilon) for aqueous copper(II) sulfate at 635 nm.
steps: Prepare five serial standard concentrations: 0.010, 0.025, 0.050, 0.075, 0.100 M CuSO4.
Zero the spectrophotometer using a deionized water blank cuvette at 635 nm.
Measure absorbance (A) and percentage transmittance (%T) for each standard solution.
Plot Absorbance versus Molar Concentration to construct the calibration curve.
Extract slope = ε · b to find molar extinction coefficient ε in L/(mol·cm).
safety: CuSO4 is an aquatic toxin and mild skin irritant. Collect all residues in designated heavy-metal waste vessel.
